'''''Star Wars: The High Republic – Shadows of Starlight''''' is a comic miniseries by [[Marvel Comics]] that was published as part of [[Phase III: Trials of the Jedi|Phase III]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The High Republic]]'' multimedia project. The series was written by [[Charles Soule]] and illustrated by [[Ibraim Roberson]], with the [[The High Republic – Shadows of Starlight 1|first]] issue published on [[October 4]], [[2023]].

The series bridges the gap between [[Phase I: Light of the Jedi|''The High Republic'' Phase I]] and III. It also features some of Soule's favorite writing for ''The High Republic''.<ref name="Soule Collection">{{Twitter|CharlesSoule|status/1785366338157924736|[[Charles Soule]]|quote=The collected edition of SHADOWS OF STARLIGHT - the comics miniseries I wrote that bridges the gap between Phases I and III of Star Wars: The High Republic - is out this week! Some of my favorite THR stuff I've done is in here - if you pick it up let me know what you think.}}</ref>
